description: DGM (Direction Generale de la Meteorologie, Morocco) weather alert bulletins covering the Jan-Feb 2026 Oued El Makhazine crisis window. Each entry is an official DGM bulletin, read on 2026-11-09 from DGM's own bulletin image or posted text. Seven bulletins are used as the evaluation reference. 'date' is the issue date and 'time' the issue time (GMT) printed on the bulletin; 'level', 'forecast_mm' and 'valid_period' are for Larache province (rain section). Use as ground-truth to compare against what the pipeline (Agent 2) would have flagged and when.

bulletins.note: first bulletin of the January-February chain naming Larache

only red for Larache in the episode; the same bulletin also has orange 40-80 mm for 2026-02-02 10:30 to 2026-02-03 12:00; confirmed by the marocmeteo vigilance map of 2026-02-02 10:57 GMT
Larache downgraded from red to orange; red stays only for Chefchaouen and Tetouan; confirmed by the marocmeteo vigilance map of 2026-02-03 10:10 GMT
issued 2026-02-04, reported by the press on 2026-02-05

usage_note: Do not cite DGM as the data source for the pipeline's own forecasts (Agent 2 uses independent open archives - GFS/ECMWF/ARPEGE via Open-Meteo). This file is for comparing the pipeline's flagged dates against DGM's real, independently-issued alert timeline in the evaluation section. Dates are issue dates, which is the comparable quantity for flag availability dates.
